source.notes: arch-011 (A13 score/reducer). Wall Attention: per-pair score s_ij = Σ_n q_in k_jn · exp(P_in − P_jn) · scale with P = cumsum(per-channel log gate g [B,T,HQ,K]); causal mask; softmax; @v. The per-channel decay sits INSIDE the channel contraction, so it is NOT expressible as an additive pairwise bias (sweep verdict) — it is the typed K1ScoreLaw.CHANNEL_DECAY score law with the channel_gate operand. The pinned base-2 form (exp2(cumsum(g)·RCP_LN2), score·RCP_LN2, base-2 softmax) equals the natural-exp form with base-e softmax at the natural scale. Verified against fla/ops/wall_attn/naive.py @ 864a87f6. Layer module: architectures/wall_attention.py.
